tei:div.tei:p: "$ (1)༄༅// gsung ngag rin po che lamaX 'brasaX bu dang bcas pa'i gzhung ༷rdo rje'iX tshig rkang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// lam 'bras gzhung khrid gces btus/ (2)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i bstan bcos rdo rje'i tshig rkang la don gsum/ phyag 'tshal zhing bshad par dam bca' ba/ gzhung don dngos bstan pa/ gzhung rdzogs par bstan pa'o/ dang po ni/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad btud de/ lam 'bras gsung mdo bri bar bya/ ༈ gnyis pa gzhung dngos la gnyis/ rgyas 'bring gsum dang*/ zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa'o/ dang po la gsum/ rgyas 'bring gsum lhan cig tu bstan pa thams cad kyi 'bras bus bstan pa/ gzhung bsdu ba'o/ dang po la gsum/ 'khor 'das thun mong*/ 'jig rten pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam mo/ dang po la bdun las/ snang ba gsum du bstan pa1/ sems can la nyon mongs pa la ma dag pa'i snang ba/ rnal 'byor pa la ting nge 'dzin la nyams kyi snang ba/ bde bar gshegs pa sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la dag pa'i snang ba'o/ ༈ rgyud gsum du bstan pa2/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang bas rtsa rgyud/ lus thabs rgyud sogs la gdan sogs gsum pa bzhis rgya'i dbang*/ lam du bskyed rim sogs lnga pa bzhis bstan/ mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig sogs bsrung*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis nyams chags bskang*/ 'dod yon lngas mnyes pa sogs bya/ lam gyi thun bzhi la dbang bzhi bsgom pas lus la brten nas bde chen gyi sgrib pa 'gag cing 'tshang rgya bar gsal bas bshad rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ni 'bras bu'i dbang bzhis thams cad mkhyen to/// / tshad ma bzhis bstan pa3/ tshad ma bzhis 'bras bu gtan la phab nas/ ༈ gdams ngag drug tu bstan pa4/ 'gal 'du'i skyon med sogs gsum gyis bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung*/ zas spyod lam/ rlung thig le/ phyag rgya ma bsten/ dwangs ma lnga'i bde ba dang dbang po lnga nyams dang ma bral bas bdud rtsir bsten/ 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi dang*/ 'khor lo rnams dang*/ gzhan rnams dang*/

sa thog mtha' re re gsum pa bcu'i bar gyi rtsa mdud dral bas la dor/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam yid 'dag pa'i rnam rtog bsgom pas lta ba'i dug dbyung*/ rnam shes lngas yul lnga ma spangs bas bdud rtsi bsten/ dag pa'i chos rnams gdod nas stong par shar bas la dor/ ༈ snyan rgyud bzhir bstan pa gsang sngags snyan brgyud sogs bzhi ma chad pa/ ༈ rten 'brel lngar bstan pa / lus khyad par can la brten nas/ dngos po'i mtha' rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gzhan dbang rten 'brel byang chub chen po'i lam/ chos thams cad rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lo rgyus kyi tshad ma/ kun gzhi rnam shes dag pa'i byang chub chen po/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lngas lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ ༈ / srung ba'i bye brag bstan pa'o/ thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i lam gyi bar chad ni/ dad pa brtan po/ srung ba'i 'khor lo/ sngags zlos/ sngags mdud/ chos rnams sems nyid snang ba/ gzhan dbang rten 'brel/ gzugs brnyan yin phyir/ de kho na nyid rgya mtsho'i (4)don dang ma bral bas bsrung*/ shes rab la phyi'i bdud lam gnyis lta grub brgyad bsgyur ba'o/ nang lam sogs bcu dang brda ma shes na 'ong*/ shes pas bsrung*/ grib dang*/ sgrib pa/ thig le 'dzag pa bsrung*/ ༈ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i lam la bdun las/ dang po ting 'dzin gyi rgyu mdor bstan pa la'ang bdun gyi dang po rgyu bstan pa/ tshogs lam nas/ tha mal pa'i lus ngag yid dang bral ba'i 'bras bus gzhi thob nas/ ༈ gnyis pa ring rgyu khams 'du lugs/ khams 'du lugs gsum gyis/ phyogs med rnams dang*/ ༈ gsum pa nye rgyu sems gnas lugs/ rlung sems bdag byin gyis rlabs nas/ ༈ bzhi pa byang phyogs ltar bstan pa/ byang chub kyi phyogs dang mthun pa'i chos sum cu so bdun ltar lam bsgrod na/ sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ las kyi rlung pho mo/

ma ning gi rlung*/ thod rgal ye shes kyi me 'bar bas khams 'dus pa dang po la/ rlung po lag cha can gyis rtse dral/ sems gnas/ rta rmi/ rtsa rlung gi zug 'byung*/ rtsa sna tshogs mdud sogs gzhi rtsa ba'i rlung sogs bcu/ zin pa'i bye brag bdun gyis/ yan lag gi rlung rim gyis nang du 'gags/ thig le mang du kha 'bu/ rten mnyam du 'gre/ ༈ lnga pa de las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin mdor bstan pa/ de la brten nas sems nang du gnas rnam shes lnga 'dus/ phung po lnga dul/ ye shes kyi 'gro ldog byed/ ༈ drug pa bsdus te bstan pa/ bsgoms pa mi 'chor ba'i mthong snang rmi lam nyams gsum gsum ni rnam rtog sngon du song ba ltar khams gsum kun tu snang ngo*/ ༈ / bdun pa lam khrid lugs gsum bstan pa'o/ sa chu la thim na smig rgyu/ chu me la thim na du ba/ me rlung la thim na srin bu me khyer/ rlung rnam par shes pa la thim na mar me 'bar ba/ rnam par shes pa 'od gsal la thim na nam mkha' sprin med pa lta bu/ sa chu me rlung dang (5)rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na/ khams gsum kun tu me lta bur snang ngo*// chu rlung dang spu lus grang*/ rlung gi rlung 'du 'phro dang*/ rang 'phur/ bya 'byung*/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung mnyam rgyu dang lha mo sna tshogs kyis gar mchod/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung sna tshogs dang*/ dri/ ro/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang spu lus bde/ bdud rtsi lnga dang de bzhin gshegs sku sogs/ sihla dang nyi ma/ ga bur dang zla ba/ rtsa phran rnams su thig phran dang skar ma/ rtsa 'dzin sogs su shing sdong sogs/ chags sdang rnam pa lnga dang*/ nyams nga*/ mya ngan/ 'dre yi rtsa/ mchil ma'i rtsar g.yal dang mchi ma/ lte bar dang po chags pa'i rigs drug gi yi ger rlung sems mnyam par 'dus na/ rigs drug gi gar/ sngags/ der khrid pa rmi lam nyams lta bur khams gsum kun du snang ngo*// oṃ las bsam gtan sogs kyi ting nge 'dzin/ yum gyi mkha' a las yang dag par thim na khams gsum nam mkha'/

yum chen mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sogs kyi pho brang du thim na chos sku nyams su myong zhing gzung 'dzin grol/ hūm̐ las gsal zhing yangs la rang byung gi ye shes nam mkha' shin tu dri ma med/ khams 'dus pa bar pa/ rlung po lag cha bri bas rtsa dral/ thig le'i zug dang mthong snang brtan to/ ༈ / mdor rgyas bsdus nas rgyas par bstan pa2/ mdor na rakṣa sogs su srin po sogs/ dril can gyi sgra/ lha'i mig rnam par dag pa bzhin srid pa'i rtse mo man chad ting nge 'dzin gyi nyams su 'byung ba snyam byed pa/ bshad kyis mi long ba mtshon cing*/ lnga bcu la gsang*/ ༈ re dogs dang bral ba'i lam bstan pa3/ sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i phyi rten 'brel rlung log sogs gsum gsum ni nang gi mkha' 'gro lnga de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lnga byang chub chen po'i rten 'brel mdzad pas/ dngos grub rnams rang las 'byung (6)bar shes shing shes pas re zhing rtsol ba'i blo sel lo/// /bdud dang gol sa rnams rang gi las dang rten 'brel du shes pas skyon yon tan du bslang zhing*/ rim pa yin min du skye bas drod byung rgyal du bskyang*/ ༈ sad pa bzhi ru bstan pa4/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i lam la/ lha'i bu'i bdud 'ong bas sad pa bzhis bsrung*/ ༈ dran pa nyer bzhag gi lam bstan pa5/ sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i dran pa nyer bzhag pa bzhi ni// yul 'gags pa na rang yi dam gyi lha dang gug skyed kyi dgos pa bsam zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam pas/ khams 'dus pa tha ma/ rlung po lag cha bral bas rtsa dral/ skye mched drug gi nang du thig le 'dus pas/ rjes su dran pa drug yang dag par shes/ sprul sku 'ga' mthong*/ ༈ de'i 'bras bu bstan pa6/ sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i yang dag par spong pa bzhi ni/ sprul sku las dbang gsum gyi rjes las byung ba'i shes pa bsam zhing*/ rjes sogs pad can bcu gnyis ma'i rtsa btsal zhing snying po'i a kundar gyi sna rtser dal rgyu sogs rig pas yid 'jug pas/

lus ngag yid rdo rje'i skyil krung bca'/ thig les rlung non pas rnga sgra sogs mi thos pas chog shes pa sogs kyi bdud chom pa'o/ nang gi sangs rgyas rnams kyi lam srid pa'i rtse mor phyin cing*/ ma skyes pa'i chos la bzod par dka' ba stong pa nyid kyi bzod pa/ dbu mar sems rtog med log /sems 'phos na bzod pa/ 'khor ba'i chos las 'das shing*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pas chos rnams kyi nang nas mchog go ༈ / de'i lam gyi mjug sdud bstan pa7'o// de ltar nyams skyon can dang*/ skyon med dang*/ phyi dbyibs kyi a nas yar rlung sems mnyam par 'dus nas/ lam du 'byung ba rnams ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid do/ ༈ / gsum pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la bzhi las/ dang po grub mtha' dang po'i dbang du byas pa la drug (7) mthong lam dang sa dang po'i sa mtshams bstan pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la// ༈ //rgyu bstan pa/ phyi nang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i lam gyis/ ༈ 'bras bu bstan pa/ sprul sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par byed pa/ ༈ lam bstan pa/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lam nas/ ༈ dbang bstan pa/ lus 'dag par byed pa bum pa'i dbang mthar phyin/ ༈ rtags brtan pa'o// de kho na nyid kyi rtags byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ rtsa rin po che'i pho brang bzhi/ gtso mo gsum ste/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor mthong nas rtogs pa'i 'gro ldog byed/ sprul sku'i zhing khams brgya bsgul zhing nyan/ sbyin brgya/ 'od brgya 'gyed/ mar brgya 'chad/ ting nge 'dzin mi 'dra ba brgya la snyoms par 'jug nus/ rigs drug gi rtsar khyad par mi'i rten mthong na dga' zhing g.yang za/ ngo tsha la skyug bro/ sngon bla mas rgyu dus su bstan pa'i 'khor 'das dbyer med de tsam na rtogs/ snying rje skye/ mchi ma ltung*/ gzhan gyi sems sna tshogs shes/ 'dod yon sna tshogs mthong bas rgod bro/

rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs skad cig mas 'byung ba rnams nang gi zhing khams mthong bas so// nang ma mthong bar phyi mi mthong*/ de tsam na liṅga brtan/ rdo rje'i rtse lhan cig skyes pa'i sar thig le gnas pa ltar/ lus sems bde bas myong zhing brgyal/ rang gzhan ngo mi shes/ nang rtags rlung sor gcig 'gag /phyi rtags gsang gnas phyed thig les brtan/ ༈ mjug sdud/ mthong lam sa dang po'o/ ༈ sgom lam sa lnga'i rnam bzhag la gsum/ dbang bstan pa/ yang sprul sku la dbang bzhi bzhi/ ༈ rtags bstan pa/ sgom lam sa gnyis pa nas/ sprul sku'i zhing khams stong la sogs pa sgal ba la sogs pa nus/ yon tan sogs 'phel/ 'gro ldog sogs 'gag /nang rtags rlung sor drug 'gag /phyi rtags gsang gnas lte snying thig les brtan/ longs sku 'ga' mthong*/ ༈ / mjug sdud do/ sgom lam (8)sa drug pa'o/ ༈ gnyis pa grub mtha' gnyis pa'i dbang du byas pa'i sa bzhi la drug /rgyu bstan pa/ yang longs sku las dbang bzhi bzhi/ ༈ lam bstan pa/ bdag byin gyis rlabs pa'i rim pa'i lam nas/ ༈ 'bras bu bstan pa/ longs sku rang bzhin gyi lhun grub thob par byed pa/ ༈ dbang bstan pa/ ngag 'dag par byed pa gsang ba'i dbang mthar phyin/ ༈ rtags bstan pa/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags dbang po lnga dang*/ dwangs ma lnga'i rlung la mnga' brnyes/ nus pa lnga dang*/ lta stangs rnams la thogs pa med/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du rigs drug gi sa bon mthong*/ sa bon drug la mnga' brnyes/ sems can rnams kyi skad du chos ston cing*/ chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la thogs pa med/ lte bar yi ge'i phyi mo brgyad ā li kā li mthong nas/ mdo sde'i chos gsungs rab yan lag bcu gnyis la thogs pa med/ bdud rtsi lnga dang ro drug la longs spyod nus// tshangs pa'i dbyangs su gyur pa rnams/ a ni yig 'bru ces sogs drug gis gsal lo/ sa bdun pa yan chad 'khor bzhi'i rgya/ longs sku'i zhing khams dung phyur la sogs pa sgul ba la sogs pa nus/

nang rtags rlung sor bcu 'gags/ phyi rtags mgrin smin thig les brtan/ ༈ mjug sdud do// sgom lam sa bcu pa'o/ ༈ / gsum pa grub mtha' gsum pa'i dbang du byas pa gnyis la drug /rgyu bstan pa/ yang chos sku las dbang bzhi bzhi/ ༈ lam bstan pa/ sems 'dag par byed pa dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i thabs kyi lam nas/ ༈ 'bras bu bstan pa/ chos sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par byed pa/ ༈ dbang bstan pa/ yid dag par byed pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang mthar phyin/ ༈ rtags bstan pa/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags stobs lnga ni/ byang chub sems kyi rlung lnga bskyod pa'i dwangs ma'i dwangs ma rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong nas/ rtags bstan pa/ sku (9)gsum ye shes lnga sogs kyi dbang thob nas// bdud rtsi lnga rtsa gar 'du ba mthong na/ sangs rgyas rnams gzhan don mdzad pa mthong*/ sprul pa bde chen du thig le 'du ba mthong na/ sangs rgyas rnams 'og min gyi gnas na zab mo la bzhugs pa mthong*/ lte ba sprul par bdud rtsi lnga dang rlung lnga 'du ba mthong na/ longs sku rigs lnga yum gyi bha ga na bzhugs nas/ skal ldan byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gsang ba sgrogs pa mthong*/ phyag rgya ma'i dwangs ma'i dwangs ma mthong na mngon shes la thogs pa med/ rtsa yig rnams su dwangs ma 'drongs na rdzu 'phrul la thogs pa med/ de nyid slar spos na sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran/ nang rtags rlung sor bcu gnyis 'gag /phyi rtags spyi gtsub hril thig les brtan/ ༈ mjug sdud do// sgom lam sa bcu gnyis pa'o/ ༈ / grub mtha' bzhi pa'i dbang du byas pa'i sa phyed la gsum/ mdor bstan gyi rgyur bstan pa/ yang dbang bzhi bzhi mthar phyin pa'i lam nas/ mthar thug rten 'brel gyi mthar thug 'dag par byed pa/ ༈ lam bstan pa/ rdo rje rba rlabs kyi lam nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub/ rig ma'i skyes bu/ srid pa rnam par dag pa'i lam/

༈ 'bras bu bstan pa/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par byed pa/ ༈ dbang bstan pa/ bzhi pa lus ngag yid gsum gyi dbang mthar phyin/ ༈ rtags bstan pa/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad ni/ rnam shes brgyad 'dag kar 'bras bu gnyis thob ste/ sa chen 'di ni dga' zhing rangs la mgu/ de rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ bdud gnas su sgra grag /phyag rgya ma'i gnas su khams gsum mthong*/ mkha' 'gro rnams ring nas 'du/ ha ri ma la sogs pa dbang phyug gi don brgyad 'char/ nang rtags srog rtsol a wa dhū tir 'jug /phyi rtags gtsug tor phyed thig les brtan/ (10)mjug sdud do/ sa phyed dang bcu gsum pa'o/ ༈ rgyas par bshad pa'i rgyu bstan pa/ bzhi pa yid kyi dbang mthar phyin/ ༈ rtags bstan pa/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'bras bu gcig thob ste/ 'bigs byed gzhon nu'i grong khyer chos kyi dbyings/ byang chub sems kyis ni 'bigs/ ༈ 'bras bu bstan pa'o/ 'bras bu longs sku'i zhing khams rab bkram la sogs bsgul ba la sogs pa nus/ ༈

rab tu rgyas par bshad pa'i rgyu bstan pa/ sa bcu gsum thob kar sa bcu ma la sogs pa yid kyis bkug ste/ slob dpon dus gsum bde gshegs bcud bsdus yin// yi dam lha dang bla ma dbyer med la bha gar/ dngos grub len pa'i rten 'brel gyis/ srid pa rnam par dag pa'i lam/ ༈ 'bras bu bstan pa/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku shin tu rnam par dag /rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par byed pa/ 'bras bu mthar phyin/ ༈ rtags bstan pa/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'bras bu longs sku'i zhing khams ma lus pa sgul ba la sogs pa nus// nang rtags srog rtsol a wa dhu tir 'gags/ phyi rtags gtsug tor hril thig les brtan/ ༈ gnyis pa lam thams cad kyi 'bras bu'i bstan pa/ phyi dang nang gi rten 'brel 'gros bzhi thim pa rnams kyis/ sgom nyams skyon yod med phyed pa sa bcu gsum pa'o// thams cad mkhyen to// bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin par rten 'brel 'grigs pa ltar snang*/ 'tshang rgya gar 'khor tshom bu gcig dang bcas nas 'tshang rgya/ ༈ gsum pa gzhung nye bar bsdus te bstan pa/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ni/ rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i dbang*/ rtogs pas brtags kyang rtogs med rtogs// ye shes snang ba de bzhin no/ ༈ spyi don gnyis pa lam zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa/ lam zab bla ma1/ dam tshig 2lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa/ ༈ gsum pa gzhung rdzogs par bstan pa/ lam (11)'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams ngag dang*/ man ngag dang bcas pa rdzogs so/ sa mā bha mi thi/ 'di la bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i rnam 'grel bcu gcig yod pa las/ gtso bo ni gnyags ma dang*/ 'grel chen sras don ma yin la gzhan dkar dang*/ dmar sogs kyis mtshon rnam bshad snga phyi shin tu mang bar bzhugs so/ ༈ rdo rje'i tshigs rkang gi bsdus don bzhugs/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ rdo rje'i tshig rkang la don gnyis ste/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing lam 'bras bshad par dam bca' ba dang*/

gzhung ngo*/ de la gnyis/ lam rgyas bsdus gsum du bstan pa dang*/ lam zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa'o/ dang po la lam rgyas pa bstan pa/ rtsa ba bzhi thar chags/ lam 'bring du bstan pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu la sogs pa lnga/ lam mdor bsdus te/ ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid gsum du bsdus/ bstan pa'o// de'i dang po la gsum/ 'khor 'das thun mong gi lam bstan pa/ 'khor lo 'cham pa 'jig rten pa'i lam bstan pa/ 'khor lo bskor ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bstan pa'o// de dag gi dang po la'ang bdun/ snang ba gsum du sems can sogs/ bstan pa'i lam/ rgyud gsum du bstan kun gzhi rgyu rgyud sogs pa'i lam/ tshad ma bzhir bstan tshad ma bzhis 'bras bu gtan la phab na pa'i lam/ gdams ngag drug tu bstan 'gal 'dus skyon med sogs/ pa'i lam/ snyan brgyud gsang sngags snyan brgyud sogs/ bzhir bstan pa'i lam/ rten 'brel lngar bstan pa'i lam/ lus khyad par can la brten nas sogs/ thabs shes kyi thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i/ phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i lam gyi bsrung ba'i bye brag bstan pa'o/ gnyis pa 'khor lo 'cham pa la bdun/ ting nge 'dzin tshogs lam nas sogs/ skye ba'i rgyu mdor bstan pa/ mdor bsdus/ mdor na rakta sogs (12)nas rgyas par bstan pa/ re dogs dang bral ba'i lam bstan pa/ sgom pa mi 'chong ba sogs/ sad pa bzhi ru shes rab sogs bstan pa/ dran pa nyer sgom pa mi 'chor ba sogs/ bzhag gi lam bstan pa/ de'i 'bras bu sgom pa mi 'chor ba'i yang dag spang ba sogs/ bstan pa/ mjug bsdus de ltar lam du 'byung ba sogs/ bstan pa'o/ gsum pa 'khor lo bskor ba la bzhi/ rgyu bstan pa rtsa bi rim gyis sbyar/ rtags bstan pa/ 'bras bu bstan pa/ mjug sdud pa'o// de ltar lam rgyas pa chos bco brgyad kyis bsdus so/ lam 'bring po la don lnga dang*/ bsdus pa la don gsum ni/ 'dir ma bris so/ lam zab mo bla ma'i lam/

'bring dam tshig gi lam/ tha ma lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa'i rten 'brel lnga'o/ lam des bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu ni bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin par rten 'brel 'grigs pa ltar snang*/ thams cad mkhyen to sogs so// sa māsta mi ṣī/ ༈ gsung ngag rin po che'i rnam 'grel don bsdus tshigs bcad ma bzhugs so// klad don mchod brjod/ na mo gu ru bir wa pa/ dam bca' las 'phros pa// rje btsun rin chen dam pa'i gsung gang zhig /mun bral zla shar 'od zer gang zhig gis// bdag lta'i blo yi mun pa bral gyur nas// rang gi sems la snang ba cung zad thob/ a seng ma/ grogs mchog dam pa thos pas rgyud sbyangs shing*// byang chub ched du sgrub pa'i go bgos nas// dam pa'i spyan sngar lung nos dam bcas pa// mi mchog khyed kyi bka' stsal lci bar 'gyur// thams cad mkhyen pa'i bka' ni rgya mtsho bzhin// zab cing gting dpag dka' la thug pa med// rdo rje'i theg pa dgongs pa du ma yis/ gsungs shing rdo rje'i tshig gis rgyas btab pa// lung bstan gyur pa klu sgrub la sogs sam// mkha' 'gros byin rlabs bir wa pa la sogs// grub thob rnams kyi gdams ngag la brten nas// rjes 'jug skye bos bka' rnams rtogs par 'gyur// don gyi gtso bo bir wa (13)la sogs pa'i// lam gyi gsung ngag khyed kyi thugs la mnga'// 'on kyang bka' drin mi 'gog pa yi phyir// rang blo las byung 'di tsam yi ger bkod/ gzhung don 'khor 'das thun mong gi lam lnga/ snang ba gsum1 gyis lam gyi gzhi bcas te// nyams myong ma lus rgyud2 gsum dag gis shes// tshad ma 3snyan brgyud 4bzhi yis spros pa gcod// rten 'brel 5lnga yis lam gyi sa 'tshams bcad/ 'jig rten pa'i lam bdun/ /'du lugs gsum dang phyogs med bdun dag gis// rnam par phye bas sgro skur bral bar mdzod// sems 'dzin 2gnas lugs rnam gsum rtogs pa yis// ting nge 'dzin gyi nye rgyu rtogs par bya// rang lus dag la nyams 3gsum skyes pa yis// gang yang ting nge 'dzin du mkhyen par mdzod// drod 4gsum rim yin min skye ba yis// gang yang byung rgyal dag tu btang bar mdzod// ded dpon lta bu'i khrid 5lugs rnam gsum gyis// ting 'dzin nyams kyi bye brag rtogs par mdzod// 'dus pa gsum6 la dpe gsum sbyar ba yis// lam gyi sa mtshams the tshom chod par mdzod// rten 'a7brel rnam gsum rang la 'dzoms pa yis// rgyu rkyen gzhan med re dogs bral bar mdzod//

gegs sel las srung ba sum cu/ /thabs dang shes rab zung 'jug rnal 'byor pa// gnyis la bar chad 'jug ste gcig la min// srung ba brgyad brgyad bcu drug dag tu ste// thabs la dad pa la sogs rnam pa brgyad// shes rab sad pa rnam pa bzhi yis bsrung*// nang gi bdud la dbang bzhi'i brda yis zlog /gnyis pa thun mong srung ba bcu bzhi ste// dang po lam la 'jug dang zhugs pa dang*// sems zin cung zad brtan dang cher brtan pa'i// bar chad rim gyis sel bar shes par bya// man ngag bdun cu/ rtsa yi zug la la dor shin tu gces// rlung gi zugs la rngan dgas byin te zlog /rlung rengs pa la la dor byin rlabs dang*/ (14)bde ba bsgom dang rnam pa gsum du gsungs/ gdams ngag drug lta sgom gnyis la dug dbyung bdud rtsi bstan// la dor man ngag drug tu shes par bya/ 'khor lo bzhi'i gegs sel/ thig le 'bar dang g.yo dang brtan pa dang*// rnam gsum dag gis bde stong mchog tu 'gyur// 'bar ba'i tshe na thig le'i zug 'byung ste/ kha sbyor dag la brtan par gyur pa dang*// dud 'gro'i 'gyur ba bzhi yis bzlog pa yis// lus la thig le g.yo ba med par bya// kun tu khyab cing brtan par bya ba'i phyir/ lus la gtun shing 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// yan lag bzhi yi rlung gi zhags pa 'phang*// bu chung spyod lam dag gis brtan par 'gyur// nyams len bsdus te bstan pa/ rje btsun dpal ldan bir wa pa yi gzhung*// dbang bzhi'i lam la lta grub brgyad kyis bsdus// skyon rnams yon tan dag tu bslang ba dang*// bar chad dngos grub dag tu bslang bar gyis// gegs sel bsdus te bstan pa/ /gang yang nyams kyi snang bar mkhyen bgyis na// bdud dang gol sa rang grol dag tu 'gyur// grub mtha' rnyogs par gdams pa/ /the tshom med par brtson pa cher mdzad na// grub mtha' rnyogs par 'gyur ro mi mchog khyed//

mjug don/ rgyas par ma bkrol ba'i rgyu mtshan/ /bdag lta 'du ba'i nang zhugs nas// sgrub la dad kyang lhod par 'gyur/ rje btsun bir wa pa yi gzhung*// yi ger bkod pa dag kyang med// rang gi sems la snang ba tsam// bkod na dam pa'i bka' las 'das// grogs kyi bka' stsal bcag gyur kyang*// mkha' 'gros dpang mdzod bzod par gsol// rje btsun rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po dpal ldan sa skya pa chen po la// mdo smad kyi dge slong byang chub sems dpa' chen po a seng gis zhus te don bsdus pa 'di mdzad do/ swa māsta mi thi/ 'di la spru lung pa kun smon dang*/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge sogs snga (15) phyi'i 'grel ba mang du bzhugs/ ༈ lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi gzhung rin chen snang ba'i rtsa ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bha drā ya// thog mar bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// rdo rje 'chang la gnyis pa'i tshig gis 'dud/ mthu stobs dbang phyug zhabs la phyag 'tshal te// bdag la thugs rje chen pos bskyang du gsol// gang zhig legs par rtogs nas sangs rgyas mchog /rdo rje 'chang gi thugs dang mtshungs gyur pa'i// 'khor 'das dbyer med tshig don bsdus pa 'di// gzhan la brtse ba'i bsam pas bri bar bya// rang bzhin gsal dang stong pa zung 'jug las// nyon mongs rlung dang yi ge rtsa dang khams// nad gdon rags pa re re'ang gsum gsum ste/ nyi shu rtsa bdun rgyu yi lhan skyes yin// de ltar lhun grub legs par rtogs gyur nas// 'khor 'das rgyu 'bras mtshan nyid shes 'gyur zhing*// phyi nang rten 'brel kun kyang legs rtogs nas// nad gdon ma lus tshar gcod byed par 'gyur// smin byed sngon du song nas sgrub pa'i lam// bskyed dang rdzogs dang ye shes rnam gsum la// rang bzhin gsum ste de dag re re la'ang*// gsum du dbye ba lam gyi lhan skyes yin// gsal ba sprul sku stong pa chos kyi sku// zung 'jug longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin te// re re'ang rnam gsum lhun grub gnas 'gyur du// brtse ba 'di ni 'bras bu'i lhan skyes yin// nyams su blang ba'i gnad gsum zhes bya ba// sems dang sgyu ma rang bzhin med pa ste// sum cu rtsa gnyis rtsa bdun dpe yis te// kun la sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kyis so// sems la gnyid dang nad gdon rdzas kyis bslad// mig yol rab rib mgal me myur 'khor ba// gnyis pa sgyu ma smig rgyu chu zla glog

/'phrog pa dri za'i grong khyer sprin dang gzha'// gsum pa gnyis kyi rten so rten 'brel te/ kha ton mar me me long rgya dang ni// me shel sa bon skyur dang brag cha ste// gsum pa'i gnyis pa brjod bral (16)bstan par bya// gzhon nu'i dgod dang lkugs pa'i rmi lam dang*// gnad la 'brug dang dbang po'i bde ba dang*// gsum pa'i ye shes gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug dang*/ longs spyod rlabs dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'o/ rgyas bshad thog mar kun gzhi'i rang bzhin dang*// rten dang brten tshul rgyu dang rtsa ba dang*// 'grel tshul snang ba gsum po dran pa yis// lus dang sems la 'khor 'das tshang tshul lo// thabs la smin byed dbang dang nyams myong ste// dang po dkyil 'khor dbang dang dbang rdzas sogs// re re'ang gdan gsum 'khor 'das dbyer med du// dpal ldan bla ma'i zhal las blang bar bya// bskyed pa sngon 'gro rten dang bskyed chog dang*/ kha dog phyag mtshan rnam 'gyur yan lag bcas// re re'ang 'khor 'das dbyer med rang bzhin du// legs par brtse ba'i bsam pas bshad par bya// rdzogs pa lus dang ngag yid 'khor ba las// 'bras bu sangs rgyas ye shes rab rdzogs par// phan tshun rgyu dang 'bras bu rgyas gdab cing*// rtogs pa dpe yi ye shes ngo sprod bya// bskyed rdzogs thun mong chos drug dran bya zhing*// rtogs pa gong nas gong du 'phel 'dod na// dam tshig brda sogs la yang legs sbyar te// dri ma med pa'i blo yis spyad par bya// 'khor ba'i nyams la brten nas log lta spang*// lam gyi nyams kyis theg pa gcig tu bsgrub// 'bras bu'i nyams kyi spro ba mchog tu 'gyur// chos kun tshad ma bzhi yis gtan la dbabs// rang bzhin rgyu la bsam na lhun grub ste// mtha' yas yon tan tshogs ni gnas 'gyur yin// des na lhun grub gnas 'gyur mi 'gal te/ 'di ni 'bras bu'i 'khor 'das dbyer med yin// thog mar bla ma dam pas bstan pa yin// lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med bsdus pa las// byung ba'i dge ba dri med mtha' yas des// 'gro kun he ru ka dpal thob par shog

/thos na lha yi dbyangs ltar (17)yid 'phrog cing*// bsam pas myong na bdud rtsi ltar tshim la// bsgom na 'chi med bcud len thob 'gyur ba'i// dpe gsum ldan pa 'di ni khyod la sbyin// yon tan 'byung gnas dpal ldan sa skya ru// me stag smal po'i yar ngo'i bco lnga la// rdo rje 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis/ rgyud kun snying po rin chen snang ba bgyis// lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi tshig le'ur byas pa rin chen snang ba zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge bsnyen rdo rje 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// rdzogs so// ༈ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid yig gzhung ji jo lcags ma'ang zer/ lta ba bzhin du dkri ba bzhugs so// rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// slob ma dad pa dang ldan pa bla mas ji skad smras pa nyan pa cig la lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gzhung shing rgyas pa'i khrid gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du dkri bar 'dod na/ thog mar snang ba gsum gyis dkri/ de nas gzhung thams cad rgyud gsum du 'du ba yin pas rgyud gsum gyis dkri de la snang ba gsum gyis dkri ba ni// ma dag pa'i snang ba/ nyams kyi snang ba/ dag pa'i snang ba gsum gyis dkri/ ma dag pa'i snang bas dkri ba la gsum/ sems can la zhes pas sems can gyi khams la brtags pas 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs shes pas de bsgom/ nyon mongs pa'i snang ba zhes pas nyon mongs ba des ngan song bskyed la/ de las byung ba dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bsgom/ ma dag pa'i snang ba zhes pas 'khrul snang dang las 'byung bas na las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa bsgom/ dang po la gsum/ 'khor ba la sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gsum bsgom/ dang po ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal bsam par bya ste/

sems can dmyal ba la grang ba'i dmyal ba brgyad (18)tsha ba'i dmyal ba brgyad/ nyi tshe ba dang nye 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rnams bsams la/ der skye ba'i thabs med ces zhag grangs ci rigs su bsgom mo// de nas 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam ste/ spyir thun mong du 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa dang*/ bye brag tu mi'i 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ dang po ni lha yi dbang po brgya byin du skyes kyang mi phan te slar sems can dmyal bar skye ba'i skabs kyang srid/ 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal por skyes kyang mi phan te slar bran du yang skye/ nyi ma dang zla bar skyes kyang mi phan te mun par yang 'jug /de la sogs pa gang thob kyang mi phan te slar 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam/ sgos mi la legs par brtags te/ phyug po sprang por 'gro ba'am/ kha drag po kha zhan por song ba la sogs pa yul mi dang nye 'brel la sogs pa dang*/ rgyal khams kyi mi la bltas la sngar gyi na mi 'dug ste 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal nges shes skyes skyes bsgom/ de nas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam te/ byas pa'i las la zin pa med pa rgas rgas shi shi byas kyang grabs la zin pa med pa/ tshe 'phos kyang de bzhin du byas pa'i las la zin pa med pa dang*/ de dag ni sems can la gces pa ste/ sems can gyi 'gro ba gang du skyes kyang skyid med pa'i bsam mno thag chod na ci byas pa chos su 'gro ba yin/ de nas dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba bsgom par bya ste/ de la yang gsum/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang*/ phan 'dogs pa che ba dang*/ thob pa'i dal ba yun ring du mi gnas pa'o/ dang po rnyed pa dka' ba bsam pa ni/ lus ma thob pa'i sems can bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ lus thob pa'ang rigs drug gi lus bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ mi'i lus la yang dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa dka' ba bsam mo// phan 'dogs pa che ba la yang gsum/

dal 'byor gyi lus 'dis tshe phyi ma'i (19)mtho ris kyang sgrub par nus pa dang*/ theg pa 'og ma'i mya ngan las 'das pa'ang sgrub par nus pa dang*/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyang 'dis sgrub par nus pa yin pas na/ shin tu phan 'dogs pa che bar bsam mo/ thob pa'i dal 'byor yun ring du mi gnas pa ni/ nges par 'chi bar bsam pa dang*/ nam 'chi cha med par bsam pa dang*/ 'chi ba la gzhan cis kyang mi phan pa bsam pa'o// dang po la gsum/ phyi nang gi 'byung ba 'khrugs pas 'chi/ log 'dren gyi bgegs 'khrugs pas 'chi/ pho lha la sogs pa gdon gzhan 'khrugs pas 'chi'o/ nam 'chi cha med pa la'ang gsum/ tshe la nges pa med pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi rkyen mang ba dang*/ mthun pa'i rkyen dkon pa'o/ 'chi ba la cis kyang mi phan pa la gsum/ glo bur gyi rkyen ma gtogs pa nges par 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa'i tshe/ rdzas kyis mi bzlog /sngags kyis mi zlog /rten 'brel gyi mi zlog pa'o// gsum pa las kyi snang ba las rgyu 'bras la yid ches pa sgom pa la gsum/ mi dge ba'i las dang*/ dge ba'i las dang*/ lung du ma bstan pa'o// dang po la'ang gsum/ mi dge ba'i las bsam/ las 'bras bsam/ de spang bar bsam pa'o// dang po ni mi dge ba bcu la bsam mno zhib tu btang*// gnyis pa mi dge ba'i las 'bras bsam ste/ ngan song gsum dang*/ mtho ris kyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad mi dge ba las 'byung nges snyam du bsam/ gsum pa de spang bar bsam ste/ des na bdag gis mi dge ba mi bya snyam du bsam mo/ dge ba la'ang gsum/ dge ba'i las bsgom/ las 'bras bsam/ de bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni dge ba bcu dang pha rol tu phyin pa bcu la bsam mno legs par gtong*/ dge ba'i las 'bras bsam te/ mtho ris rnam pa gsum dang*/ mtho ris gsum gyi phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang dge ba las byung ste/ (20)sbyin pas longs spyod 'grub ces bya ba la sogs pa bsam mo// gsum pa de bsgrub par bsam ste/

yon tan de lta bu yod pa'i phyir bdag gis dge ba ci 'grub tu bya'o snyam du bsam mo// lung du ma bstan pa la'ang gsum/ lung du ma bstan pa'i las bsam// las 'bras bsam/ de dge bar bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni dge ba dang mi dge ba'i bsam pas ma zin pa'i zas za ba dang*/ gos gon pa dang*/ gnyid log pa la sogs pa rnams yin no// gnyis pa de'i las 'bras bsam ste/ de'i las ni 'bras bu gang yang skye bar mi 'gyur ro// gsum pa de dge bar kha lo bsgyur bar bya ste/ byang chub kyi sems sngon du song bar byas nas zas zos pa dang*/ gnyid la sogs pa thams cad dge bar kha lo bsgyur nas 'gro ba yin no// de ltar de dag la bsam mno legs par thag chod nas// spyi don gnyis pa/ nyams kyi snang ba bsgom par bya ste/ de la gnyis/ rnal 'byor la zhes pa thun mong gi rnal 'byor pas/ thun mong gi nyams kyi snang ba rgyud la skyes skyes bsgom pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pas skye bar 'gyur ba'i nyams la nges shes skyes skyes bsgom pa'o// dang po la gsum/ byams pa bsgom pa/ snying rje bsgom pa/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'o// dang po la gsum/ nye ba la byams pa bsgom pa/ dgra la byams pa bsgom pa/ de thams cad la bsre ba'o// dang po ni ma la byams pa bsgom/ de dang gnyen bsre/ de dang tha mal pa bsre ba'o// de dag gi bsgom tshul yang*/ ma 'di drin che bas bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig snyam du bsam/ gnyis pa de bzhin du gnyen rnams kyis kyang ma ma byas pa med do// gsum pa dgra dang tha mal pa rnams kyis kyang ma ma byas pa med pas thams cad bdag gi ma yin snyam du bsam/ snying rje bsgom pa la gsum/ yul sems can sdug bsngal (21)gyis nyan pa rnams la sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig snyams pa'i sems can la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang*/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu'ang ma rig pa las byung ba yin pas ma rig pa dang bral bar 'dod pa chos la dmigs pa'i snying rje dang*/

sems can thams cad ngo bo nyid kyis yang dag par ma grub pa yin yang sems can thams cad 'dzin pa dang bcas pa la dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje bsgom par bya'o// byang chub kyi sems sgom pa la'ang gsum/ smon pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ 'jug pa'i bdag nyid can dang*/ don dam pa'i byang chub kyi sems so// dang po la'ang gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyang theg pa gsum gyi sgo nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la bzhag pa dang*/ rigs can gsum ka'ang rim gyis sbyangs la nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag snyam du bsam mo// 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems la'ang gsum/ bdag gzhan mnyam pa bsgom pa dang*/ bdag gzhan brje ba bsgom pa dang*/ de dag gi spyod pa la bslab pa'o// dang po ni/ bdag sdug bsngal spong bar 'dod pa bzhin sems can gyi sdug bsngal yang spang*/ bdag bde ba bsgrub pa bzhin sems can yang bde ba la 'god snyam pa la sogs pa bsam par bya'o// gnyis pa brje ba bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad kyi las dang mi dge ba thams cad bdag la smin par gyur cig /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang dge ba thams cad sems la dbul bas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde bar gyur cig snyam du bsam// gsum pa ni/ des na lus dang longs spyod dang dge ba thams cad sems can la phul bar bsam zhing ci 'grub pa'i tshul gyis (22)byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad la slob par bya'o// thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams kyi snang ba skye bar 'gyur ba la nges shes bsgom pa ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam zab mo la zhugs nas nyams kyi snang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig skye bar 'gyur te/ de rnams kyi mthun pa'i phyogs la dga' ba skye rgyu'ang med/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs du ma byung yang mi dga' ba skye rgyu'ang med de/

rang gi rtsa dang*/ rtsa yi ge dang*/ khams bdud rtsi dang*/ snying po ye shes rlung gi rten 'brel sems kyis dbang byas pa la brten nas nyams sna tshogs su 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ de ltar nyams bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ang*/ bsdu na bco lngar 'du ste/ lam gsum dang*/ drod gsum dang*/ rten 'brel gsum dang*/ nyams gsum dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gsum du 'du'o// bco lnga po yang ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig tu 'du ba yin no zhes nyams ma skyes pa'i gong nas nyams la spros pa chod par byas la lan cig nyams nam skyes pa'i tshe/ 'di ni nyams lus nyams so// 'di ni sems nyams so zhes bya ba la sogs pa ngo shes par byas la byung rgyal gyis bskyang bar bya'o// dag pa'i snang ba bsgom pa ni/ sku mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa dran par byas la sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa bsgom ste/ lan cig ngas 'di lta bu thob par 'gyur ba yin snyam du spro ba khyad par can bsgom par bya'o// snang ba gsum gyi dkri ba'i skabs bstan zin to// de'i rjes kho na la rgyud gsum gyis dkri bar bya ste/ de la gsum/ rgyu chos nyid 'khor ba'i gnas lugs/ lam bsgom pa'i tshul/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'o// dang po ni 'dir mi bshad de ma dag pa'i snang bar bstan zin to// lam la gsum ste/ gzhi dam tshig la gnas par bya ba dang*/ gang zag (23)dkri ba'i tshul gang yin pa dang*/ nges shes khyad par can bskyed la/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes par bya zhing*/ lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par gzhag pa'o// dang po ni/ lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin zhing gang zag 'bring gi lam gyi gtso bo yin pas dam tshig nyi shu bskyang bar bya ste/ dbang dang dam tshig la gnas pa ni/ lam thams cad kyi gzhi yin no// de la gnas pas gang zag thams cad dkrir rung ngo*// gnyis pa dkri tshul la gsum/ lta bas spros pa bcad pa'i phyir kun gzhi rgyu rgyud 'khor 'das dbyer med bsgom/

lam gyi nyams bskyed pa'i phyir lus thabs rgyud bsgom/ 'bras bu sku lnga mngon du gyur pa'i tshul lo// dang po la'ang gsum/ lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyi sgo nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba mdor bstan/ nyams su blang ba'i chos gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad/ rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas shin tu rgyas par bshad do// dang po ni/ slob ma khrid pa'i tshe bla ma la gsol ba gdab cing mos gus drag po zhag 'ga' byed du gzhug /de nas ngo 'phrod pa'i tshe chos thams cad sems su 'dus ste sems las ma gtogs pa'i chos gang yang med do zhes nges shes bskyed la thog mar gsal ba ngos gzung*/ de nas stong pa ngos bzung*/ de lta bu'i gsal ba dang stong pa gnyis po so sor sangs rgyas kyis kyang dbyer mi 'dod de zung 'jug yin no zhes ngo sprad la nges shes skyes skyes bsgom du gzhug /skyes nas lhan cig skyes pa'i chos nyi shu rtsa bzhi bstan pa spros pa bcad la spros pa chod chod bsgom du gzhug /gnyis pa ni/ de nas chos thams cad sems su bsgrub pa'i dpe brgyad kyis chos thams cad sems su nges shes skyes skyes bsgom du gzhug ste/ de ni sems las ma gtogs pa'i phywa'am dbang phyug rdul phran la sogs pa byed mkhan gzhan med par spros pa (24)gcod pa yin no// de nas sgyu mar bsgrub pa'i dpe brgyad kyis chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur nges shes skyes skyes bsgom du gzhug go /de ni sems rang la yang bdag med de sems nyid kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs kyi stobs kyi rgyu rkyen sna tshogs la brten nas 'bras bu sna tshogs skye bas na sems su zhen pa'i spros pa gcod pa yin no// de nas sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub pa la gnyis/ rten 'brel du bsgrub pa dang*/ brjod bral du bsgrub pa'o// dang po ni/ dpe brgyad kyi sgo nas nges shes skyes skyes su bsgom ste/

de ni sgyu ma zhes bya ba'i rgyu rkyen rang bzhin gyis grub pa gcig kyang med la/ rgyu 'bras bur 'ong ba'ang med cing*/ rgyu la ma brten par 'bras bur 'byung ba'ang med pas na 'gro 'ong med cing skye 'gag med par sgrub pa'i dgos pa yin no// de nas brjod bral du bsgrub pa'i dpe brgyad kyi sgo nas brjod bral du nges shes skyes skyes bsgom ste/ de'ang brjod bral nyams su myong yang 'di lta bu gcig yin no zhes yod pa dang med pa'i sgo nas brjod du yang mi gtub la/ brjod bral nyid la zhen pa med pa'i nyams skyes skyes su dpe'i gtso bo bzhi btus la re re'i steng du'ang chos bzhi bzhi gtan la dbab pa dang*/ gtso bo gcig btus la de'i steng du chos thams cad gtan la phab la nges shes skyes skyes bsgom par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de nas rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud dang*/ lam thabs rgyud dang*/ 'bras bu'o// dang po ni chos bdun gyi sgo nas kun gzhi rgyu rgyud la 'khor 'das tshang ba'i nges shes bskyed la bsgom par bya'o// de nas lam thabs rgyud la gsum las/ dbang la nges shes bskyed pa dang*/ lam la nges shes bskyed pa dang*/ nyams la nges shes bskyed pa'o// dang po la gsum/ dkyil 'khor la 'khor 'das bsre ba/ dbang la 'khor 'das bsre ba/ dbang gi ye shes la (25)'khor 'das bsre ba bsgom/ de nas lam la 'khor 'das bsre ba/ dbang bzhi'i lam so so la 'khor 'das bsres la nges shes bskyed/ de nas nyams kyi snang ba la 'khor 'das bsre ste/ ma dag pa'i nyams kyi snang ba la brten nas las rgyu 'bras la nges shes khyad par can bsgom/ lam nyams kyi snang ba la brten nas lam thams cad theg pa gcig tu bsgrub/ 'bras bu'i nyams kyi snang ba la brten nas 'bras bu sangs rgyas la mos gus bskyed/ de nas gnas 'gyur dang lhun grub mi 'gal ba'i sgo nas 'bras bu 'khor 'das dbyer med la nges shes bsgom par bya'o/

de ltar de dag la nges shes skyes nas thos bsam gyi lta ba mthar phyin cing sgom byung gi ye shes cung zad skyes pa zhes bya ba yin no// kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi khrid bstan zin to// gnyis pa lam gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir lus thabs rgyud bsgom pa ni/ de nas sgrub pa la 'jug pa'i sngon du bla ma la lam dus kyi dbang blang te dam tshig gso/ bla ma mi bzhugs na bdag nyid kyis sgrubs pa'i dkyil 'khor bris la bdag 'jug rgyas par bya/ mi mthun pa'i rkyen spangs nas mthun pa'i chas 'grigs pa'i tshe sgrub pa la 'jug ste/ de'ang bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lam la brten nas bsnyen pa bzhi 'bum la sogs pa ci 'grub pa bzla/ de'i bcu cha zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya/ de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa la brten nas sems gzung bar bya ste lha'i spyan sgom/ gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ ces bya ba la sogs pa'i tshul gyis sems gzung zhing lam sbyang*/ nang nas skyes pa'i lta ba ngo bo nyid bskyang ste snang ba dkyil 'khor du gsal bar 'dod na gsal bar 'gyur ba'i bar du bskyang ngo*// de nas yang grub na bla ma las dbang blang*/ ma grub na bdag 'jug bya/ de'ang ma grub na maṇḍal dang yi ge brgya pa la brten nas mthun pa'i rkyen tshogs bsags pa dang*/ 'gal rkyen sgrib pa sbyangs la/ lus sbyang rgyas bsdus ci 'grub pas lus sbyang 'byongs 'byongs sbyang ste/ re zhig 'byongs pa'i tshad ni dka' las med cing na tsha med la lus bde zhing yang ba yin no// kha cig la skabs der ting nge 'dzin (26)shugs kyis skye ba'ang srid do// gang ltar yang lus sbyong yun ring du sbyangs nas ting nge 'dzin yun ring du skye zhing bar chad mi 'byung ba yin no/ de nas rlung gi sbyor ba bdun bsgom/ kha sbyar du slebs pa dang gtum mo'i dmigs pa bco brgyad/ spel zhing bsgom/

'di rnams kyi skabs su bogs 'byin rnam pa brgyad kyis bogs dbyung ba dang*/ gdams ngag drug gis nad kyang 'di dag gi skabs su dgos pa yin no// de ltar gtum mo'i gdams ngag gis lam sbyang zhing lta ba rang byung gi ye shes rnyed rnyed du bsgom mo// 'dis khams 'dus pa dang por 'gro ste/ bsrung ba sum cu dang gegs sel rnams kyang lhus che bar 'di dag gi skabs su dgos pa yin no// de nas dngos sam ye shes kyi phyag rgya la brten nas dbang gsum pa'i lam bsgom ste/ 'dis khams 'dus pa bar pa thig le bde stong nyams kyi lam khrid pa yin no// de nas dbang bzhi pa rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom ste/ 'dis khams 'dus pa tha ma skyon med gnyug ma ye shes kyi lam khrid pa yin no/ des na 'di dag ni gang zag blo tha ma rim gyis dkri ba la dgongs pa yin gyi/ kha cig la snang ba gsum gyis khrid bor te lta ba nas skyong ba yang yod do// 'di man chad gang ltar yang lta ba la nges shes skyes nas nas ni sgom du cis kyang 'jug la/ de man chad gang zag gi rigs la nges pa med de/ kha cig bskyed rim kho na nas bskyang ba yang yod mod kyi/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug 'di nyid kyi bzhed pa ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'i dmigs pa cung zad cig brtan par byas nas lus sbyong dang rlung kho na gtso bor byed pa yin no// rlung dang gtum mo'i dmigs pa rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu'am lam zhes bya ba lta ba rang byung gi ye shes la ting nge 'dzin nyid ces bya bas na de nam skyes pa dang bskyang ba yin no// sngar thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i lta ba de ni skyon can yin la/ 'di ni lta ba skyon med dam dpe'i ye shes zhes bya ba'am/ (27)lam phyag rgya chen po zhes bya ba yin no// des na rgyu mi dbang 'bras bu mi 'byung bas/ rtsa rlung gang gtum mo'i dmigs pa la brten nas lta ba rang byung gi ye shes lam phyag rgya chen por skye bar 'gyur pas na rgyu la nan tan bya'o// yang gang zag gi rigs kha cig sngar bstan pa'i khrid thams cad lo gcig tsam gyis sbyangs nas ngag 'dren pa zhi pa'ang lo gcig tsam sbyang*/

de nas ngag drag po rlung kha sbyar la brten nas ting nge 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs 'ba' zhig bsgom pa'ang yod de// 'di ni brtson 'grus mchog gi 'jug pa zhes bya ba yin no// gang zag dkri ba'i tshul bstan zin to// gsum pa nges shes khyad par can bskyed la ting nge 'dzin ngo shes par bya zhing lam gyi sa mtshams rnam par bzhag pa la gsum/ tshad ma bzhi dang snyan brgyud bzhis nges shes bskyed pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin ngo shes shing sa mtshams bzhag pa dang*/ 'khor lo bskor ba grub pa'i rtags dang bcas pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ khams 'dus pa dang po dang bar pa dang tha ma'o// 'khor lo bskor ba la bzhi/ grub mtha' dang po dang*/ gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa'o// de dag gis ni sngar gang zag dkri ba'i tshul bstan pa'i gang zag gi gnas skabs gang du sleb ces brtags shing dkri dgos pa yin no// lam khrid tshul bstan zin to// 'bras bu sku lnga rang bzhin lhun grub kyi sangs rgyas ni 'bras bu 'chad pa'i skabs nyid du rtogs par bya bas na 'dir bshad mi dgos so// gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du dkri ba'i gzhung shing sngar yi ger bris pa med kyang rang gi slob ma dad gus ldan zhing mon bod kyi mtshams nas dka' ba cher byas nas 'ongs pa rigs brgyud dang ldan pa'i lho brag pa dkar ston jo sras lcags kyi rdo rjes lan mang du gsol ba btab nas bris pa yin no/ 'di bris pa las byung ba'i bsod nams kyis nam mkha'i (28mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur tu thob par gyur cig /bdag cag lam sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor pa thams cad kyi lam gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig /rdzogs so//

'di khrid yig thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin/ 'di la brten nas bla ma dam pa tshar ngor sogs kyi 'khrid yig shin du mang ngo*/ ༈ /lam 'bras kyi gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i khrid yig tshigs bcad ma bzhugs so// dpal ldan bla ma'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal te/ rdo rje 'chang la gnyis pa'i tshig gis 'dud// mdo rgyud bstan bcos kun gyi snying po'i don// nyung ngu'i tshig gis brjod par bya yis nyon// sdug bsngal sdug bsngal ngan song gsum gyi gnas// mdze nad shu ba'i steng na rma 'bras bzhin// legs par bsam na bsran par ga la nus// de bsam mi dge'i las las ldog par bya// mtho ris gsum na'ang 'gyur dang 'du byed de// dang po mtho dman 'gyur bar bsam par bya// gnyis pa bya bas zin par ga la 'gyur// des na dang po 'khor ba'i nyes pa bsam// dben sar gnas nas bsam gtan bsgom pa la// byis dang 'grogs na dben pa mi thob pas// skye bo dag la skyo ba bsgom bya ste// 'di yis dben pa thob cing log 'tsho sdang*// de ltar 'jig rten rnam rtog btang nas ni// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*// bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i byang chub sems// don dam byang chub sems kyang bsgom par ba// de ltar bsam kyang tshe 'dir sred pa na// mi rtag pa ni thun mtshams thams cad du// yang yang dran par bya yi mi rtag pa// rtag tu mi bsam dus 'das dgos med phyir// byang chub sems gnyis bsgom pa'i thun mtshams su// mdo bklag dkon mchog mchod la brtson par bya// pha rol phyin pa'i gzhung (29)lugs mdor bsdus nas// snying po don gyi man ngag 'di dag yin// de tsam gyis kyang blo gros ma gang ba'i// blo chen sbyangs pa zab mo dag la mos// rdo rje 'chang chen myur tu thob 'dod pa// de la rdo rje theg pa sbyin par bya// bla ma brgyud pa dang ldan rgyud don rig /dam tshig mchog srung man ngag du mas brgyan// snying rjes rgyud brlan bstan bcos du ma shes// de yi zhabs bsten gsol ba lan mang btab// de yis gnang nas dkyil 'khor chen po ru// zhugs nas dbang bzhi po rnams rdzogs par blangs// byin rlabs phra mo tsam gyis ma yin te// sngags kyi rtsa ba dbang bskur yin pas so// de nas rtsa ba yan lag bcas pa yi// dam tshig la ni byang bas nan tan bya/

de tsam gyis kyang skye ba bcu drug nas// 'grub la lam rnams kun gyi gzhi yin no// de ltar snod dang ldan pa'i gang zag la// bskyed rim lam gyi yan lag bcas bstan nas// bzlas brjod sbyin sreg dag gi rgyud sbyangs nas// de nas lta ba dag la blo sbyang ngo*// dang po dngos kun sems su bsgrub bya ste// sems las ma gtogs 'di na gzhan 'ga' med// rang sems 'khrul pa'i bag chags kyis bslang ngo*// rmi lam rta glang mig gi rab rib bzhin// sems de ngo bo nyid min sgyu ma ste// smig rgyu chu zla gtsubs pa'i me bzhin du// sna tshogs rkyen rnams tshogs nas snang ba tsam// 'di yi sems gyi rang bzhin gang yin smos// sgyu ma zhes bya ngo bo nyid kyang ni// 'di na med cing rten cing 'brel 'byung nyid// skye dang 'gags dang gnas pa yod min na// brjod bral 'di la ci zhig bsam par bya// brjod med brjod pa 'di la don med cing*// bsam min bsam par bya ba'i gnas min la/// /(30)bsgom du med pa 'di la ci zhig bsgom// de ltar shes na 'dzin pa med par 'gyur// lta ba yang dag bsam pas blo sbyangs nas// de nas rim gnyis bsam gtan bsgom par bya// bskyed pa'i rim nas rim gyis blo sbyang ngam/ de nyid rten du 'dzin te blo rigs gnyis// dad pa bskyed pa'i rim pa nyid la ni// blo yi snang ba thob kyi bar du ste// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa'i lhan cig skyes// gang rung sngon du song nas rdzogs rim bsgom// rdzogs rim zab mo kun gyi sngon 'gro ni// sbyang ba rnam gsum de nas rlung la bslab// sbyor ba rnam bdun gtso bo bum pa can// sangs rgyas lam ni kha sbyor dag la gnas// 'di ni 'chi ba med pa'i bcud len te// 'di ni rgas pa med pa'i sman gyi mchog /mthu stobs du ma sgrub par byed pa'ang 'di// rim gnyis rten 'brel brtan par byed pa'ang 'di// rang byin rlabs pa gtum mo phra thig gsum// las kyi phyag rgya dngos dang ye shes gnyis// de ltar rdzogs rim rnam pa gnyis kyi yang*// sngon 'gro sbyang pa sbyong ba bstan pa yin// kha sbyor dang bral zab mo'i man ngag kun// rim gyis 'phul bar byed pa'i lam yin gyi// myur tu 'grub par byed pa ma yin pas// de phyir kha sbyor lam la gus par bya/

sangs rgyas yon tan kha sbyor dag na gnas// kha sbyor bsgom pa'i sgrub pa po dag la// sngon du lus sbyang yun ring gces pa ste// nyams myong skyes nas lta ba dag ngang bsre// rang sems gdod nas spros bral rgyu rgyud dang*// dbang gi ye shes lam gyi lta ba dang*// nyams myong sangs rgyas pa la ngo bo gcig /rtogs pa'i sangs rgyas zla ba'i dpe yis bstan// 'ga' zhig phyag rgya chen po thog bab ces// thog mar ston byed rmongs pa 'ga' smra mod// de ni de min (31)lta ba'i bsam gtan te// sgom pa'i shugs 'byung phyag rgya chen po yin// de ltar rim gnyis lam la sbyor ba yis// drod thob nas ni spyod pas brtan byas la// sa rnams bsgrub nas nye rgyus mtshams sbyar bas// rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon du thob par 'gyur// dge bsnyen rnal 'byor grags pa rgyal mtshan la// rgyas min snying po'i don la mos pa yi// dad gus dang bcas bra ston blo gros kyis// gsol ba btab nas sa skyar sbyar ba yin// snying po'i snying po blangs nas bstan pa 'di// tshigs bcad nyi shu rtsa bdun 'di dang brgyad// legs par sbyar ba las byung dge ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar bgrod shog /nyes pa'i tshogs rnams bla ma rnams dang sangs rgyas kyi spyan sngar bshags shing*// dge bas sems can thams cad la bsngo ba dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis slob ma dkri tshul 'di la gtso bor mdzad do// ༈ gzhung ji lta ba bzhin dkri ba'i khrid yig tshigs bcad ma rgyud gsum lam gyi rim pa'i bsdus don bzhugs so// rje btsun bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa la gsum ste/ lam rim la 'jug pa'i yan lag /yan lag can gyi lam rim/ lam rim mthar phyin pa'i bya ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/

dpal ldan/ mdo bshad par dam bca'o/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ phar phyin theg pa'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs pa// sbyangs nas rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim dngos la 'jug pa'o// dang po la gsum/ spang bya 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa/ brten bya lam gyi rim pa bsgom pa/ de dag gi mjug bsdu ba'o/ pha rol/ dang po la gsum/ sdug (32)bsngal gyi sdug bsngal bsam pa/ sdug bsngal gzhan bsam pa/ ngan pa'i grogs spang ba bstan pa'o/ des na/ /dang po la gnyis/ sdug bsngal gyi ngo bo/ sdug bsngal/ de'i rgyu spang bar bstan pa'o/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ mtho ris/ mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// 'di la gnyis/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam pa/ 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsam pa'o/ gnyis pa/ /gnyis pa la gsum/ sbyor ba mi dge'i/ skyabs su dkon mchog 'gro ba'i rim pa// dngos gzhi byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i rim pa/ rjes thun dang po/ mtshams su bya ba'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ don dam byang chub kyi sems don dam/ bsgom pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ mi rtag pa bsgom pa/ de ltar/ tshogs bsags pa'o/ byang chub/ /gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa'i lam rim dngos la gsum/ lam gyi rtsa ba bla ma bsten tshul/ bsten nas lam gyi rim pas blo sbyang ba/ sbyangs pa'i lam gyi 'bras bu'o/ rdo rje/ /dang po la gsum/ de tsam gang gis sten pa slob ma'i mtshan nyid/ gang bsten pa bla ma'i rang bzhin/ bla ma'i/ des de ji ltar bsten pa'i tshul lo// gnyis pa la gsum/ dbang gis smin par bya ba/ smin pas rgyud sbyang ba/ sbyangs nas lam bsgom pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ cho ga rdzogs pa/ dkyil 'khor/ smin byed rnam dag tu bstan pa/ de las gzhan pa byin rlabs smin byed du mi rung bar bstan pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ bsrung bya dam tshig sbyang ba/ de nas/ bsnyen bya bzlas brjod de ltar/ kyis rgyud sbyang ba'o/ gsum pa la bzhi/

dngos po thams cad la zhen pa spang ba lta ba'i khrid/ rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor rim gnyis la gnas pas drod thob nas spyod pa bya (33)tshul/ spyod pa la gnas/ pa rnams/ pas nye rgyu bsgom tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ de nas/ snang ba sems su/ sems de sems sgyu mar/ sgyu ma rang bzhin med par bsgrub pa'o// 'di la gnyis/ rten 'brel du dang*/ sgyu ma brjod brjod bral du bsgrub pa'o/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ rim gnyis de nas spyi'i rnal 'byor/ so so'i rnal 'byor ro// 'di la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor ro// dang po la gnyis/ bskyed pa'i mdor bstan/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// 'di la gnyis/ las dang po pas dang po bsgom bya'i bskyed rim/ brtan pa thob pas gnyis pa bsgom bya'i bskyed rim mo// gnyis pa la gsum/ sngon 'gro sgo gsum sbyong ba/ rdzogs dngos gzhi'i lam sbyang ba/ rjes lta ba bskyang ba'o/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ lam gyi dngos gzhi/ de dag gi yan lag go/ de ltar/ dang po la gnyis/ rang byin rlabs/ las dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'o// dang po la gnyis/ khyab byed kyi man ngag de nas/ khyab bya'i man ngag go/ rang byin/ gsum pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa/ nyams/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// 'di la gnyis/ rang lugs bzhag pa/ gzhan lugs dgag pa'o// dga'/ bzhi pa la gnyis/ de ltar spyad pa'i/ de ltar/ sngon du drod thob nas spyod pa/ spyod par bya'o// gsum pa la drug / dge bsnyen gang dag gang gis/ rgyas min dgos pa ci'i phyir/ rang sems/ gnas gang du/ sa skyar/ snying po tshul ji ltar/ tshig grangs du zhig brtsam pa/ legs par/ rtsom pa'i dge ba bsngo ba'o// rgyud gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa'i bsdus don shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can rnams la phan thog par gyur cig /sarba dā maṅga lam bha ba tu//(34)
